summary.description: High-level summary of the documentation drift audit.

scanned_files.description: Total number of documentation files inspected.

drift_count.description: Total count of confirmed drift items.

rule_id.description: Copy the rule_id from the same shown pre-pass candidate as candidate_id (doc-broken-link, doc-broken-anchor, doc-missing-file, doc-deleted-reference, or doc-missing-symbol). Do not invent a model-only rule or cite an unrelated candidate id.

path.description: Relative path of the markdown document containing the drift.

line_number.description: Line number where the drift was identified.

snippet.description: Excerpt or line showing the outdated or broken reference.

title.description: Brief human-readable summary of the drift.

description.description: Detailed explanation of what drifted between spec and codebase.

candidate_id.description: Expected on every confirmed or dismissed row: copy the candidate_id of the pre-pass candidate this row answers verbatim from Scanner Data. The docs-drift scanner stamps every candidate; do not invent an id. The factory compares cited ids against presented ids (agents-w9ni). Deliberately NOT in `required` (agents-0ydyn): a schema violation rejects the whole report at parse time, before the repair that gives a row with no id the one presented candidate its own path and line_number name can run (agents-op02b), so a required id turned a repairable omission into a lost run - while a row that cannot be repaired is still refused by that repair and the station reads INCOMPLETE.

false_positive.description: True when this candidate was evaluated and REJECTED (a dismissal recorded as evidence, not work). Every candidate the pre-pass supplied must appear in findings, either as a confirmed issue or as a dismissal (agents-f8dj).

remediation.description: Actionable instructions to resolve the drift.
